resolution.summary: Implemented bridged Advanced Podcast with shared Rust identification and provenance for up to four Hollyland segmented microphone streams, exact-duration continuous clips, source/binding validation, staggered shared-clock synchronization and cross-segment waveform verification, high-bleed relative-dominance routing, many-to-many microphone/camera assignment, and automatic camera-only lead/tail cropping. Canonical create/history/dry-run/idempotency and browser archive roundtrip covered. Four real microphones (12 WAV files) synchronized to supplied camera with 32 RMS and 20 waveform windows; zero drifting/unverified results. Production WASM and isolated Next build pass, final configured check covers 66 focused tests, types and changed podcast lint.

remaining.summary: Actual media snapshot contains four microphones and one camera. Additional cameras, human speaker/camera correctness, perceptually seamless final playback and live graphical UI/export have not been verified; perfect lip sync/100% classification not asserted.

Global architecture audit reports unchanged existing violations in MoveElementCommand, brand-kits/apply.ts and subtitles/auto-texts.ts. Full commands.ts lint also has two existing object-parameter errors outside this change; changed podcast code lint passes with an existing hook dependency warning.

Built locally without deployment, activation of a running production app, final export or modification of source recordings. Other recorder naming schemes and ambiguous/midnight/mixed sessions require an explicit supported adapter; current observed Hollyland names and appended user labels are supported.
